events.text: Goal achieved: Land on the Moon
Goal achieved: Drill for water ice
Surface operations funding: Stable operations funding gives the drill team better support for its work.
Tracking the descent: Partner tracking gives the flight team better support during descent.
Descent engine software patch: Responsive supplier support improves confidence in the descent engine.
Rehearsed landing: The moved launch cut rehearsals short, leaving the landing team less prepared.
